paragraphs.text: The path from Sandcove to Fenn Head is 11 kilometres long and takes about four hours. A short section near Gull Bay is closed until May because of a landslide; walkers should follow the yellow diversion signs.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: There is drinking water at the Sandcove car park and at the café in Fenn Head, which is open from Easter to October. The last bus back to Sandcove leaves at 6.15 pm.
paragraphs.label: B

items.quote: is 11 kilometres long and takes about four hours

explanation.en: “11 kilometres long” → 11 kilometres. Four hours is the walking time.
explanation.kk: «11 kilometres long» → 11 kilometres. Four hours — жүру уақыты.
explanation.ru: «11 kilometres long» → 11 kilometres. Four hours — время в пути.

items.quote: walkers should follow the yellow diversion signs
items.prompt: What colour are the diversion signs?

explanation.kk: «the yellow diversion signs» → yellow. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.
explanation.ru: «the yellow diversion signs» → yellow. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.

items.quote: closed until May because of a landslide
items.prompt: Until which month is the section near Gull Bay closed?

explanation.en: “closed until May” → May. Easter and October refer to the café.
explanation.kk: «closed until May» → May. Easter пен October — кафе туралы. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.
explanation.ru: «closed until May» → May. Easter и October — про кафе.

items.quote: The last bus back to Sandcove leaves at 6.15 pm
items.prompt: When does the last bus leave?

explanation.kk: «leaves at 6.15 pm» → 6.15 pm. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.
explanation.ru: «leaves at 6.15 pm» → 6.15 pm. Жауабы мәтінде нақты көрсетілген.
